_comment: What the assistant knows about Chicky's screens. Update this when you add or change UI (see .github/pull_request_template.md). Each element's guideId must match a data-guide-id attribute on that page; AppGuideConsistencyTest checks both directions. Keep summaries to one line: they are sent with every message.

shared.description: Round mic button in the bottom-right corner of every page. Opens the assistant, where the user can say or type their sales.

pages.title: Dashboard
pages.summary: Home page: total portions sold in the latest 7 days, sales by dish, revenue and gross profit for those days, the dishes that earn the most, and a box to talk to the assistant.

elements.description: Menu button at the top left. Opens links to the Demand forecast, Data ingestion and Dishes pages.
Link to the Demand forecast page, inside the top-left menu.
Link to the Data ingestion page, inside the top-left menu.
Link to the Dishes page, inside the top-left menu.
Profile picture at the top right. Opens the user's name and email and the Log out button.
Line chart and total of portions sold per day, all dishes combined, for the 7 days ending on the latest recorded sale.
Bar chart of portions sold per dish over the same 7 days.
Revenue for the same 7 days as the charts, with gross profit and margin. Dishes without a price are named here and not counted as $0; the Set prices link goes to the Dishes page.
The dishes that made the most gross profit in those 7 days, with the margin per plate.

Revenue by day for the last 53 weeks, one square per day like a GitHub calendar: darker teal means more revenue, grey means no sales, an outlined square means closed. Hovering shows the amount; Show as a table lists each month.

Things to do now, worked out from the stall's data: days with no sales logged (Add sales opens a form for that day), uploaded files not imported yet, dishes without a price, and a public holiday coming up, with how the same holiday went last year. Each card can be dismissed.
Large text box for typing or speaking to the assistant, e.g. to record today's sales.

pages.title: Demand forecast
pages.summary: Predicts how many portions of a dish will sell on a date, using past sales, weather and public holidays.

elements.description: Menu button at the top left. Opens links to the Dashboard, Data ingestion and Dishes pages.
Link back to the Dashboard, inside the top-left menu.
Link to the Data ingestion page, inside the top-left menu.
Link to the Dishes page, inside the top-left menu.
Profile picture at the top right. Opens the user's name and email and the Log out button.
Drop-down to choose which dish to forecast.
Date to forecast, from today up to 7 days ahead. Dates beyond the NEA weather forecast use the dish's past sales only.
Button that runs the forecast for the chosen dish and date.
Predicted portions, the likely range, how the forecast was worked out (the model, or an average of past sales such as the last 4 Saturdays, and why), and the chart of past sales for the chosen dish.
Switch the chart between the last 7 days and the same weekday in past weeks.
Weather, holiday, event and disruption factors behind the forecast.

pages.title: Data ingestion
pages.summary: Upload CSV or Excel files of past sales and import them into daily sales, see the files uploaded so far, and set the stall's opening days (weekly rest days and one-off closed days).

elements.description: Menu button at the top left. Opens links to the Dashboard, Demand forecast and Dishes pages.
Link to the Dashboard, inside the top-left menu.
Link to the Demand forecast page, inside the top-left menu.
Link to the Dishes page, inside the top-left menu.
Profile picture at the top right. Opens the user's name and email and the Log out button.
Area to drop a CSV or XLSX file onto, or click to choose one (maximum 25 MB).
Uploads the chosen file. Disabled until a file is chosen.
Table of uploaded files, when they were uploaded, their size, whether the model uses them, and an Import sales button that turns a file's rows into daily sales.

Shown after an upload or after pressing Import sales: what is in the file (rows, dates, problems by row) and, for each dish name in the file, which dish to record it as, a new dish, or leave it out. Days that already have sales can be kept or replaced.
Imports the file's rows into daily sales, inside the import panel. Nothing is saved before this is pressed.
Opening days section at the bottom of the page: the stall's weekly rest days and one-off closed days. Closed days aren't counted as days with no sales and aren't forecast.
Monday to Sunday buttons. Ticking a day makes it a weekly rest day; changes save straight away.
Pick a date and an optional reason (e.g. centre cleaning), then press Add closed day. Added days are listed below with a Remove button.

pages.title: Dishes
pages.summary: Each dish's selling price and cost per portion, used for revenue and gross profit on the Dashboard.

elements.description: Menu button at the top left. Opens links to the Dashboard, Demand forecast and Data ingestion pages.
Link to the Dashboard, inside the top-left menu.
Link to the Demand forecast page, inside the top-left menu.
Link to the Data ingestion page, inside the top-left menu.
Profile picture at the top right. Opens the user's name and email and the Log out button.
Each dish's price and cost per portion in S$, the margin per plate, and a Save button per dish. A new price applies from today; earlier sales keep their price.

tasks.summary: Record today's (or another day's) sales by talking to or typing to the assistant.

steps.message: Tap this mic and say what you sold, like "today chicken rice 42, char siew 30". You'll see a card to check before anything is saved.

tasks.summary: See how many portions were sold recently, in total and per dish.

steps.message: This shows the portions you sold each day for the latest 7 days, all dishes together.
And this splits the same 7 days by dish.

tasks.summary: Predict how many portions of a dish will sell on a coming day.

steps.message: First choose the dish you want to plan for.
Then pick the day. Today or tomorrow works best, because the weather forecast only covers the next 24 hours.
Press this to get the forecast.
The predicted portions appear here, with your past sales for comparison.

tasks.summary: Set or change what a dish sells for and costs to make, so revenue and gross profit can be shown.

steps.message: Type the price and cost of one portion next to the dish, then press Save. A change applies from today.

tasks.summary: See how much was made recently and which dishes earn the most.

steps.message: This is your revenue for the latest 7 days, with gross profit once your dish costs are set.
And these dishes made the most profit, with what you keep on each plate.

tasks.summary: Upload a CSV or Excel file of past sales (a date, dish and quantity sold column) and import it, so the dashboard and forecasts can use it without typing the sales in.

steps.message: Drop your CSV or Excel file here, or click to choose it.
After uploading, check how each dish name will be recorded and press Import. Your files are listed here, with an Import sales button to import one again.

tasks.summary: Set the stall's weekly rest days and one-off closed days (e.g. hawker centre cleaning), so they aren't counted as days with no sales and aren't forecast.

steps.message: Tick the days of the week your stall is always closed. They save straight away.
For a one-off closure, pick the date, add a reason if you like, and press Add closed day.
